title: Weighted absolute-power inequality
statement: Let $s$ be a finite set, let $w,F:s\to\mathbb R$, and suppose $w(a)\ge0$ for every $a\in s$, $\sum_{a\in s}w(a)=1$, and $q\ge1$. Then $\left|\sum_{a\in s}w(a)F(a)\right|^q\le\sum_{a\in s}w(a)|F(a)|^q$.
hypotheses_covered: $s$ is a finite subset of a type
$w,F$ are real-valued functions on the ambient type
replaced: Let $s$ be finite, let $w_i\ge0$ for $i\in s$ satisfy $\sum_{i\in s}w_i=1$, and let $F_i\in\mathbb R$ and $q\ge1$. Then $|\sum_{i\in s}w_iF_i|^q\le\sum_{i\in s}w_i|F_i|^q$.
